title: Capability
description: A feature or permission that enables specific financial operations on a Moov account, such as the ability to send or receive funds.

accountID.description: The account this capability belongs to.

status.description: Current activation status of the capability.

requirements.description: List of requirements that must be fulfilled to activate this capability.

disabledReason.description: Explanation of why the capability is disabled, if applicable.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the capability was created.

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the capability was last updated.
